subset_note: Representative 12-subcategory subset for demonstration. Not the full CSF 2.0 catalog.

controls.title: Identities and credentials for authorized users are managed
Access permissions and authorizations are managed, incorporating least privilege
Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events
Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored
Potentially adverse events are analyzed to better understand associated activities
Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded
Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk
Configuration management practices are established and applied
Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk
Secure software development practices are integrated and their performance monitored
The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties
Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident
